name: Supabase Auth
description: Authentication provider built on Supabase: @supabase/ssr root middleware that refreshes the session and protects configured paths, getCurrentUser/requireAuth helpers, and /api/auth/me — all honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit. Layer on top of the supabase template.

questions.prompt: Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)?

checklist: Sign-in/sign-up wiring is your responsibility — use supabase.auth.signInWithPassword / signInWithOAuth from the supabase template's client
Set AUTH_MODE=mock in development; middleware short-circuits to MOCK_USER from shared-types
Set AUTH_MODE=real (or unset) in production — this template's middleware overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware
getCurrentUser uses Supabase's server-validated getUser() — never authorize off getSession() locally
Configure protected_paths above; middleware redirects unauthenticated requests under those prefixes to /login
